The '''Iotran Expanse''', also known as '''Iotran Space''' or '''Iotran Territories''',<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> was the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]].

It was inhabited by the [[Iotran/Legends|Iotran]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the Expanse include [[Gettiarn]] and [[Iotra]] itself.
